amcLogoUrl.about: The ArmorCode mark (the circles, without the white wordmark, which vanishes on light backgrounds): host assets/armorcode-mark@2x.png, shown 28px high

iconBaseUrl.about: Where the eyebrow badge images are hosted, with no trailing slash: host the PNGs in assets/icons/ there, shown 20px high

dashboardUrl.about: The live dashboard in ArmorCode (today’s “View Full Dashboard on ArmorCode Platform” link)

dashboardImageSrc.about: The dashboard snapshot today’s email shows: a `cid:` reference to the inline image attachment, or a hosted https URL. Shown 520px wide, so an image about 1040px wide is sharpest

customEmailSubject.about: The subject the report’s owner wrote; the default subject when empty

customEmailBody.about: The message the report’s owner wrote. Rendered from markdown today: give it as already-rendered HTML
